local function deactivateAll()
	Dominus.BackgroundColor3 = colorOff
	Money.BackgroundColor3 = colorOff
	Gems.BackgroundColor3 = colorOff
	Spins.BackgroundColor3 = colorOff

	for i in pairs(activated) do
		activated[i] = false
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------
-- CODE
local function infMoney()
	task.spawn(function()
		while activated.money do
			task.wait()
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.SpinPrizeEvent:FireServer(8)
		end
	end)
end

local function infSpin()
	task.spawn(function()
		while activated.spins do
			task.wait()
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.SpinPrizeEvent:FireServer(7)
		end
	end)
end

local function infGems()
	task.spawn(function()
		while activated.gems do
			task.wait()
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.SpinPrizeEvent:FireServer(5)
		end
	end)
end

local function infDominus()
	task.spawn(function()
		while activated.dominus do
			task.wait()
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.SpinPrizeEvent:FireServer(4)
		end
	end)
end

--GUI
Money2.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
	if not activated.money then
		deactivateAll()

		activated.money = true
		Money.BackgroundColor3 = colorOn
		infMoney()
	else

	end
end)

end)
